nom: Decorté Sun Shelter Multi Protection Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+

segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report no white cast and good wear under makeup, though one notes an oily T-zone that needs a light powder touch-up later in the day.
segments.dry: One reviewer describes normally dry skin as surprisingly hydrated by the sunscreen, with no dryness reported.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one usually sensitive to any SPF above 25 and one with combination-sensitive, melasma-prone skin, report no stinging, breakouts or reaction.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the formula as non-greasy and comfortable under makeup even on combination or slightly oily areas, though one notes needing a powder touch-up on the T-zone by evening in hot weather; one reviewer specifically praises it for not turning oily under makeup the way other sunscreens do on her sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or melasma-affected skin report no new breakouts while using the sunscreen daily under makeup.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers using the sunscreen with hyperpigmentation or melasma report their dark spots looking less pronounced or better concealed after weeks of daily use.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, including on tan or deeper skin tones
Doubles as a smooth makeup primer
Luxury packaging that is bulky for travel
May need a powder touch-up in heat on oily areas

extraits.texte: I received this complimentary from decortebeauty. It was a really small tub so I can't speak on its long term effects but the texture is nice if that is something you are looking for. It has a scent but it isn't too strong.

I absolutely love this sunscreen. I have very sensitive skin and also have had problems with sunscreen that make my skin oily under makeup. This sunscreen is light and effective in protecting my skin from the sun and keeping it fresh all day. I would repurchase and totally recommend!

I recently received this product complimentary from @decortebeauty in exchange for my honest review. I am genuinely very happy with this sunscreen! The Sun Shelter Multi Protection Sunscreen is a broad spectrum SPF 50+ that checks all the boxes for me. I especially love the higher SPF level for solid protection, plus the nice lightweight formula that absorbs super quickly into the skin—no white cast, no greasy residue, and no pilling at all. It has this light, heavenly floral scent that's subtle and really pleasant without being overpowering. It feels incredibly comfortable to wear all day, whether layered under makeup or on its own, and it's surprisingly hydrating for my normally dry skin. Over the weeks I've been using it, I've noticed my complexion looking more radiant and even-toned, with my dark spots appearing less pronounced. My skin just feels so soft, supple, and healthy overall. This has quickly become my go-to daily sunscreen—it's a true standout and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for effective, comfortable, and skin-loving protection!

extraits.titre: Elegant, Lightweight, and No White Cast
extraits.texte: Complimentary from decortebeauty Ive been exploring Japanese skincare lately, and Decorte has been one of my favorite discoveries so far. The Sun Shelter Multi Protection SPF 50+ feels incredibly lightweight and smooth on the skin. No greasiness, no pilling, and absolutely zero white cast (even on my warm-tan skin tone). It layers beautifully under makeup and leaves a soft, dewy finish that makes my skin look fresh, not shiny. I live in Hawaii, so daily sun protection is a must, and this has quickly become my go-to for outdoor days. No irritation, no clogged pores, just elegant sun care that feels like luxury skincare. If youre looking for a high-performance sunscreen that feels invisible but works hard, I highly recommend this one. Skin type: Combination Skin tone: Medium-tan with warm undertones Concerns: Hyperpigmentation, dullness, texture Would I repurchase? 100% yes!

Decorte Sun Shelter Multi Protection Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ is lovely! I am 38, I have naturally tan colored skin, I have acne prone skin, and I wear makeup almost every day. This sunscreen sits well on my face after all my normal skincare and then layering makeup on top of that. It doesnt leave a white cast, just a beautiful, hydrated, glowing complexation. I not only feel protected from the sun, but this works as a primer and moisturizer for my makeup as well. It is a thick cream that spreads out easily and absorbs very well. It has a very light and pleasant scent that makes me feel fancy when I use it! I love that my skin looks radiant all day long when I am wearing this sunscreen. I definitely recommend this unique multi-purpose sunscreen, just remember to apply it as the last thing in your skincare routine. I received this product complimentary from Decorte in exchange for my honest opinion.

I absolutely love the Decorté skincare line and the Sun Shelter Multi Protection SPF 50+ is another product that I can't live without now that I have been introduced to it! I happen to suffer from severe melasma hyperpigmentation on my cheeks and forehead so SPF is an absolute Must in my skincare regimen daily, this product is so silky smooth and applies so evenly on my combination sensitive skin without leaving any white cast. I have also experienced no issues with breakouts which is very important to me. It works very well under makeup without caking or separating my foundation and concealer. I have honestly noticed my skin looks better and much brighter after using this sunscreen daily. I highly recommend this product and the entire Decorté skincare line. It's fabulous! complimentary from decortebeauty

reserve: Several of the supplied reviews (describing a lotion, emulsion, setting spray, lip serum or cotton pads) discuss other Decorte products gifted in the same campaign rather than this sunscreen, and were excluded from this reading; the reviews that clearly describe the sunscreen itself skew heavily positive, leaving few critical, on-topic accounts to draw on.
